section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the participants of a single study, referred to as 'this study'. The sample consisted of 322 female university students from Greater London, with a mean age of 24.72 and a mean BMI of 21.67. The majority (63.7%) were of European Caucasian descent.
section_summary.evidence_source: The participants of this study were 322 female university students enrolled in a number of courses at a university in Greater London (age M = 24.72, SD = 5.90; BMI M = 21.67, SD = 3.48). The majority of participants were of European Caucasian descent (63.7%), while the remainder were of Asian descent (13.7%), African Caribbean descent (13.7%), or other ancestry (9.0%).
